                       OFFICE OF PUBLIC UTILITY COUNSEL'S
                         NOTICE OF CHANGE OF COUNSEL

       Pursuant to 16 Tex. Admin. Code § 22.101(b), the Office of Public Utility Counsel (OPUC)

notifies the Public Utility Commission of Texas, the State Office of Administrative Hearings, and

all parties to this proceeding that Chris Ekoh has been removed as an attorney of record for OPUC

in this docket. Additionally, Michael Martinez has been added as an attorney of record for OPUC

in this docket. Annanya Chaturvedi remains lead counsel in this matter. Please direct all future

filings and communications to the undersigned attorneys.


Date: September 23, 2026
                                            Respectfully submitted,
                                            Benjamin Barkley
                                            Chief Executive and Public Counsel
